_comment: Curated 13F clone list for alpha-hunt. CIKs are reused verbatim from the investment skill's data/superinvestor-ciks.json (already verified). Research finding: clone LOW-turnover concentrated funds — the 45-day 13F filing lag is nearly free for a 3-year holding but fatal for fast-turnover funds. 'cloneability' tags which funds survive the lag. Only clone NEW high-conviction positions (>=7.5% of the fund's disclosed portfolio). This is a SLOW confirming signal, low weight — never a primary trigger.

clone_rule.avoid: fast-turnover funds — lag destroys their edge
